# Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd

Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd is the parent company of three businesses:

- Starling Bottle and Pure Water Factory: bottled water and pure water production, with locations at Abijo and Bogije. Phone: +234 705 554 8653, 0812 934 2879.
- Royal Retreat Bakery: a bakery.
- Elite Royal Suite and Hotel: a hotel and hospitality business.

## Structure

- Homepage: about the company, our businesses, our values, FAQ and contact
- Business pages: /starling-water/, /royal-retreat-bakery/, /elite-royal-suite-hotel/
- Legal pages: privacy policy and cookie policy
